reason: The README describes a DSH integration that forwards images to a configured vision API and exposes image descriptions to a non-vision primary model, with installation scripts and adapter patches.

summaries.zh: 通过配置的视觉模型接口将会话图片转换为文字描述，并为 DSH 主模型提供 view_image 看图工具。
summaries.en: Connects DSH to a configured vision model API to turn session images into text descriptions and provide a view_image tool to the primary model.

capabilities: Sends user-provided images to a configured external vision API for text descriptions
Provides a view_image tool that accepts local paths, URLs, and data URLs
Installs plugin files and modifies DSH settings and adapter behavior
Reads an API key from a configured environment variable or local configuration file
